units.text: EXT. SKYLINE ROOFTOP BAR - NIGHT
Detective Sergeant Alana Reyes sits at a corner table with a club soda.
Across from her, Assistant District Attorney Colm Brennan, in a loosened tie, nurses a bourbon.
Neither has touched the appetizers.
String lights sway.
The city hums far below.
Chain of custody on the Delacroix evidence. Tell me what's wrong with it.
units.name: ALANA

units.text: Nothing's wrong with it. It's thin, Alana. Thin is not wrong.
units.name: COLM

units.text: Thin is how it gets tossed at the suppression hearing.
units.name: ALANA

units.text: Locker 14 was logged out at 2210 and the bag was sealed at 2305. That's fifty-five minutes where a lawyer drives a truck through.
units.name: COLM

units.text: Officer Pak was on scene the whole time. She'll testify.
units.name: ALANA

units.text: She'll testify she was on scene. She won't testify nobody touched it.
units.name: COLM

units.text: A long beat.
A waiter passes.
Neither speaks until he is gone.
Alana picks at the label on her bottle.
I need you to file anyway. Monday. Before the defense gets wind of the gap.
units.name: ALANA

units.text: You're asking me to walk into a courtroom knowing I might lose the whole case on a paperwork error.
units.name: COLM

units.text: I'm asking you to walk in knowing the man did it.
units.name: ALANA

units.text: That's not the standard. You know that's not the standard.
units.name: COLM

units.text: Then give me the standard. Tell me what I need, and I'll go get it.
units.name: ALANA

units.text: Get me Pak's written statement. Notarized. By Friday.
units.name: COLM
paren: he looks at the folder, at the city, at her

units.text: Friday.
units.name: ALANA

units.text: She leaves the folder.
He pulls it back toward himself and finally, finally starts to read.
